name: playbooks/truenas/configure_vm_bridge.yaml
review_question: Does this playbook have harmful dependency coupling?
source_context:
1: ---
     2: # Create tagged, IP-less VM bridges on the TrueNAS spare trunk port.
     3: # Additive and zero-downtime: the primary interface (enp2s0f0), its host
     4: # IPs, and the docker macvlan networks are never touched.
     5: #
     6: # Topology: truenas_vm_trunk_parent (enp1s0f0) is cabled to a tagged-only
     7: # switch trunk (crs317 sfp-sfpplus13, frame-types admit-only-vlan-tagged;
     8: # 1G module for now). For each entry in truenas_vm_bridges this play
     9: # creates vlan<tag>@trunk and a host bridge enslaving it, with NO host
    10: # IPs — pure L2 for VM taps. VM<->host traffic (e.g. the democratic-csi
    11: # portal at 10.10.9.213) hairpins through the switch between the trunk
    12: # port and the primary port: standard two-port forwarding.
    13: #
    14: # STP is disabled on these bridges: a single-member edge bridge cannot
    15: # form a loop, and the Linux STP listening/learning delay (~30s) on
    16: # newly-attached VM tap ports can outlast an iPXE DHCP window.
    17: #
    18: # Safety: uses the TrueNAS stage -> commit(rollback) -> checkin flow, and
    19: # the post-commit state is verified BEFORE interface.checkin — an assert
    20: # failure aborts the play inside the rollback window, so TrueNAS reverts
    21: # the change on its own at checkin_timeout. No host IPs move, so SSH
    22: # stays up throughout.
    23: #
    24: # Idempotent and health-checking: a converged re-run stages nothing but
    25: # still asserts the trunk link, the bare-L2 invariant, and that every
    26: # bridge/VLAN pair exists.
    27: #
    28: # Variables (igou-inventory group_vars/truenas.yml):
    29: #   truenas_vm_trunk_parent — spare physical NIC cabled to the tagged trunk
    30: #   truenas_vm_bridges      — list of {name, vlan_name, vlan_tag}
    31: 
    32: - name: Configure TrueNAS tagged VM bridges
    33:   hosts: truenas
    34:   gather_facts: false
    35:   become: false
    36: 
    37:   tasks:
    38: 
    39:     - name: Assert trunk and bridge variables are defined
    40:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    41:         that:
    42:           - truenas_vm_trunk_parent is defined
    43:           - truenas_vm_bridges | default([]) | length > 0
    44:         fail_msg: >-
    45:           truenas_vm_trunk_parent / truenas_vm_bridges are missing — define
    46:           them in group_vars/truenas.yml.
    47: 
    48:     - name: Query current network interfaces
    49:       ansible.builtin.command:
    50:         argv: [midclt, call, interface.query]
    51:       register: _ifquery
    52:       changed_when: false
    53: 
    54:     - name: Parse interface state
    55:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    56:         _ifaces: "{{ _ifquery.stdout | from_json }}"
    57: 
    58:     - name: Compute missing VLAN sub-interfaces and bridges
    59:       vars:
    60:         _iface_names: "{{ _ifaces | map(attribute='name') | list }}"
    61:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    62:         _missing_vlans: "{{ truenas_vm_bridges | rejectattr('vlan_name', 'in', _iface_names) | list }}"
    63:         _missing_bridges: "{{ truenas_vm_bridges | rejectattr('name', 'in', _iface_names) | list }}"
    64: 
    65:     - name: Note whether staging is needed
    66:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    67:         _changes_needed: "{{ (_missing_vlans + _missing_bridges) | length > 0 }}"
    68: 
    69:     - name: Locate the trunk parent interface
    70:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    71:         _trunk: "{{ _ifaces | selectattr('name', 'equalto', truenas_vm_trunk_parent) | list }}"
    72: 
    73:     - name: Assert the trunk parent exists
    74:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    75:         that: _trunk | length == 1
    76:         fail_msg: >-
    77:           {{ truenas_vm_trunk_parent }} does not exist on this host — check
    78:           truenas_vm_trunk_parent in group_vars/truenas.yml.
    79: 
    80:     # An unconfigured port is administratively down at boot, so a plain
    81:     # link_state check cannot tell "no cable" from "admin down". Bring it
    82:     # up ephemerally for the probe; the middleware owns (and persists) the
    83:     # up state once the VLAN/bridge config is committed.
    84:     - name: Bring the trunk parent up for the link probe (ephemeral)
    85:       become: true
    86:       ansible.builtin.command:
    87:         argv: [ip, link, set, dev, "{{ truenas_vm_trunk_parent }}", up]
    88:       changed_when: false
    89: 
    90:     - name: Probe trunk link state (up to 10s)
    91:       ansible.builtin.command:
    92:         argv:
    93:           - midclt
    94:           - call
    95:           - interface.query
    96:           - '[["name", "=", "{{ truenas_vm_trunk_parent }}"]]'
    97:       register: _trunk_probe
    98:       changed_when: false
    99:       failed_when: false
   100:       retries: 5
   101:       delay: 2
   102:       until: >-
   103:         ((_trunk_probe.stdout | from_json | first | default({})).state
   104:          | default({})).link_state | default('') == 'LINK_STATE_UP'
   105: 
   106:     - name: Assert the trunk parent has link (cable present)
   107:       ansible.builtin.assert:
   108:         that: (_trunk_probe.stdout | from_json | first).state.link_state == 'LINK_STATE_UP'
   109:         fail_msg: >-
   110:           {{ truenas_vm_trunk_parent }} has no link — check the cable/module to
   111:           the tagged switch trunk port (crs317 sfp-sfpplus13) and confirm the
   112:           switch config is deployed before running this play.
   113: 
   114:     - name: Assert the trunk parent is a bare L2 port (no IPs, no DHCP/SLAAC)
   115:       ansible.builtin.assert:
   116:         that:
   117:           - _trunk[0].aliases | length == 0
   118:           - not _trunk[0].ipv4_dhcp
   119:           - not _trunk[0].ipv6_auto
   120:         fail_msg: >-
   121:           {{ truenas_vm_trunk_parent }} has IP configuration — refusing. This
   122:           play only manages a bare tagged trunk; move or remove the IPs first.
   123: 
   124:     - name: Refuse to run with pending uncommitted interface changes
   125:       ansible.builtin.command:
   126:         argv: [midclt, call, interface.has_pending_changes]
   127:       register: _pending
   128:       changed_when: false
   129:       # midclt prints Python-style booleans here ("False"), not JSON
   130:       failed_when: _pending.stdout | trim | lower != 'false'
   131:       when: _changes_needed
   132: 
   133:     - name: Stage VLAN sub-interfaces on the trunk
   134:       ansible.builtin.command:
   135:         argv:
   136:           - midclt
   137:           - call
   138:           - interface.create
   139:           - >-
   140:             {{ {'name': item.vlan_name,
   141:                 'type': 'VLAN',
   142:                 'description': 'VM trunk VLAN ' ~ item.vlan_tag
   143:                                ~ ' (' ~ truenas_vm_trunk_parent ~ ')',
   144:                 'vlan_parent_interface': truenas_vm_trunk_parent,
   145:                 'vlan_tag': item.vlan_tag} | to_json }}
   146:       loop: "{{ _missing_vlans }}"
   147:       loop_control:
   148:         label: "{{ item.vlan_name }}"
   149:       changed_when: true
   150: 
   151:     - name: Stage IP-less bridges enslaving the VLAN sub-interfaces
   152:       ansible.builtin.command:
   153:         argv:
   154:           - midclt
   155:           - call
   156:           - interface.create
   157:           - >-
   158:             {{ {'name': item.name,
   159:                 'type': 'BRIDGE',
   160:                 'description': 'VM bridge (tagged VLAN ' ~ item.vlan_tag
   161:                                ~ ' via ' ~ truenas_vm_trunk_parent ~ ', no host IPs)',
   162:                 'bridge_members': [item.vlan_name],
   163:                 'stp': false} | to_json }}
   164:       loop: "{{ _missing_bridges }}"
   165:       loop_control:
   166:         label: "{{ item.name }}"
   167:       changed_when: true
   168: 
   169:     - name: Commit staged changes (no host IPs move — SSH stays up)
   170:       ansible.builtin.command:
   171:         argv:
   172:           - midclt
   173:           - call
   174:           - interface.commit
   175:           - '{"rollback": true, "checkin_timeout": 60}'
   176:       changed_when: true
   177:       when: _changes_needed
   178: 
   179:     - name: Query interfaces after commit
   180:       ansible.builtin.command:
   181:         argv: [midclt, call, interface.query]
   182:       register: _postquery
   183:       changed_when: false
   184: 
   185:     - name: Assert every VM bridge and VLAN sub-interface exists
   186:       vars:
   187:         _post_names: "{{ _postquery.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"
   188:       ansible.builtin.assert:
   189:         that:
   190:           - item.name in _post_names
   191:           - item.vlan_name in _post_names
   192:         fail_msg: >-
   193:           {{ item.name }}/{{ item.vlan_name }} missing after commit — aborting
   194:           before checkin so the pending change auto-rolls back at
   195:           checkin_timeout; check `midclt call interface.query` and the
   196:           middleware log.
   197:       loop: "{{ truenas_vm_bridges }}"
   198:       loop_control:
   199:         label: "{{ item.name }}"
   200: 
   201:     - name: Check in — persist the verified changes
   202:       ansible.builtin.command:
   203:         argv: [midclt, call, interface.checkin]
   204:       changed_when: true
   205:       when: _changes_needed
   206: 
   207:     - name: Report next steps
   208:       ansible.builtin.debug:
   209:         msg: >-
   210:           Tagged VM bridge(s) ready:
   211:           {{ truenas_vm_bridges | map(attribute='name') | list }}. Next: run
   212:           configure_vms.yaml. The L2 path proves itself end-to-end when a VM
   213:           PXE-boots (DHCP from rb5009 arrives via the trunk).

     2: # Per-Pi netboot staging: netboot server first, then the router.
     3: #   1. rpis group: resolve contract + TFTP prefix + rootfs src per host.
     4: #   2. netboot_server group: rpi_rootfs role per managed Pi (NFS rootfs
     5: #      + full boot-partition TFTP staging), then fetch each Pi's shared
     6: #      boot assets (firmware/kernel/dtb) to the controller cache.
     7: #   3. rpis group (serial): upload the shared <model>/<build_id> set to
     8: #      the router's flash once (size-gated dedup across Pis on the same
     9: #      build) and register this Pi's per-prefix /ip tftp rows pointing
    10: #      into it. Pin files (config.txt/cmdline.txt) are owned by
    11: #      converge_boot_mode.yml, not staged here.
    12: #
    13: # Scope with -e rpi_group=<group> — not --limit. The plays mix rpis
    14: # with netboot_server, and play 2 loops over the rpis group from the
    15: # netboot_server host, so --limit silently empties it.
    16: - name: Resolve per-Pi config and rootfs sources
    17:   hosts: "{{ rpi_group | default('rpis') }}"
    18:   gather_facts: false
    19:   tasks:
    20:     - name: Resolve effective rpi config
    21:       ansible.builtin.include_tasks: tasks/_resolve_rpi_config.yml
    22: 
    23:     - name: Resolve rpi_rootfs_src per host
    24:       ansible.builtin.include_tasks: tasks/_resolve_rootfs_src.yml
    25:       when: rpi_netboot_managed
    26: 
    27: - name: Provision per-Pi NFS rootfs + stage and fetch boot assets
    28:   hosts: "{{ rpi_netboot_server_group | default('netboot_server') }}"
    29:   become: true
    30:   gather_facts: false
    31:   vars:
    32:     _managed_pis: >-
    33:       {{ groups[rpi_group | default('rpis')]
    34:          | map('extract', hostvars)
    35:          | selectattr('rpi_netboot_managed', 'defined')
    36:          | selectattr('rpi_netboot_managed')
    37:          | map(attribute='inventory_hostname') | list }}
    38:     # (host, asset) cross-product for the fetch loop. Built with
    39:     # targeted attribute access only: piping full hostvars dicts through
    40:     # subelements() forces EVERY inherited var to render, and fact-less
    41:     # plays then explode on unrelated vars that template ansible_facts
    42:     # (baseline_user_groups' os_family lookup, first hit at the bench).
    43:     _fetch_pairs: >-
    44:       {%- set out = [] -%}
    45:       {%- for h in _managed_pis -%}
    46:       {%-   for a in hostvars[h].rpi_tftp_assets -%}
    47:       {%-     set _ = out.append({'host': h,
    48:                                   'cache_dir': hostvars[h].rpi_tftp_cache_dir,
    49:                                   'asset': a}) -%}
    50:       {%-   endfor -%}
    51:       {%- endfor -%}
    52:       {{ out }}
    53:   tasks:
    54:     - name: Run rpi_rootfs per Pi
    55:       ansible.builtin.include_role:
    56:         name: rpi_rootfs
    57:       vars:
    58:         rpi_rootfs_src: "{{ hostvars[_pi].rpi_rootfs_src }}"
    59:         rpi_rootfs_src_sha256: "{{ hostvars[_pi].rpi_rootfs_src_sha256 | default('') }}"

    61:         rpi_rootfs_force_refresh: "{{ rpi_force_refresh | default(false) }}"
    62:       loop: "{{ _managed_pis }}"
    63:       loop_control:
    64:         loop_var: _pi
    65: 
    66:     - name: Ensure controller cache dir exists per host
    67:       ansible.builtin.file:
    68:         path: "{{ hostvars[item].rpi_tftp_cache_dir }}/{{ item }}"

    74:       # has PrivateTmp, so an SSH-delegated mkdir creates a private /tmp

    77:         ansible_connection: local

    83:         src: "{{ rpi_image_cache }}/rpi-tftp/{{ item.host }}/{{ item.asset }}"
    84:         dest: "{{ item.cache_dir }}/{{ item.host }}/{{ item.asset }}"

    86:       loop: "{{ _fetch_pairs }}"
    87:       loop_control:
    88:         label: "{{ item.host }}/{{ item.asset }}"

    92:   gather_facts: false
    93:   # One Pi at a time: every host's uploads delegate to the same router,
    94:   # and parallel net_put bursts flake RouterOS's SSH server.

    96:   vars:
    97:     _shared_dir: "{{ rpi_tftp_flash_dir }}/shared/{{ rpi_board_model }}/{{ rpi_build_id }}"
    98:     # Every build still referenced by a managed Pi of this model — the
    99:     # prune step below must not delete a sibling Pi's active build.

   101:       {{ groups[rpi_group | default('rpis')]
   102:          | map('extract', hostvars)
   103:          | selectattr('rpi_netboot_managed', 'defined')
   104:          | selectattr('rpi_netboot_managed')
   105:          | selectattr('rpi_board_model', 'equalto', rpi_board_model)

   110:       when: rpi_netboot_managed

   112:         - name: Assert the TFTP prefix is derivable

   117:             commands:
   118:               - >-
   119:                 :if ([/file find name="{{ item }}" type=directory] = "")
   120:                 do={/file add name="{{ item }}" type=directory}
   121:           register: _shareddir
   122:           retries: 3
   123:           delay: 5
   124:           until: _shareddir is succeeded
   125:           changed_when: false
   126:           loop:
   127:             - "{{ rpi_tftp_flash_dir }}/shared"
   128:             - "{{ rpi_tftp_flash_dir }}/shared/{{ rpi_board_model }}"
   129:             - "{{ _shared_dir }}"
   130: 
   131:         - name: Retarget this Pi's rows onto the current build dir
   132:           ansible.builtin.include_tasks: transport/retarget_tftp_row.yml
   133:           vars:
   134:             _retarget_req: "{{ rpi_tftp_prefix }}/{{ item }}"
   135:             _retarget_real: "{{ _shared_dir }}/{{ item }}"
   136:           loop: "{{ rpi_tftp_assets }}"
   137: 
   138:         - name: Upload each shared asset + register this Pi's row
   139:           # Reuses the armbian domain's generic size-gated primitive —
   140:           # it only consumes _upload_* vars. The shared path is keyed by
   141:           # build_id (immutable content), so the size gate is safe and
   142:           # dedups the upload across Pis on the same build.
   143:           ansible.builtin.include_tasks: ../armbian/transport/upload_file.yml
   144:           vars:
   145:             _upload_local_src: "{{ rpi_tftp_cache_dir }}/{{ inventory_hostname }}/{{ item }}"
   146:             _upload_remote_path: "{{ _shared_dir }}/{{ item }}"
   147:             _upload_req_filename: "{{ rpi_tftp_prefix }}/{{ item }}"
   148:             _upload_req_filename_is_regex: false
   149:           loop: "{{ rpi_tftp_assets }}"
   150: 
   151:         - name: Prune shared build dirs no longer referenced by any Pi of this model
   152:           community.routeros.command:
   153:             commands:
   154:               - >-
   155:                 /file remove
   156:                 [find where name~"^{{ rpi_tftp_flash_dir }}/shared/{{ rpi_board_model }}/"
   157:                 and !(name~"({{ _active_builds | join('|') }})")]
   158:           register: _prune
   159:           retries: 3
   160:           delay: 5
   161:           until: _prune is succeeded
   162:           # Unconditional remove — RouterOS gives no removed-count back,
   163:           # so report changed rather than hide real mutations from AAP
   164:           # run summaries.
   165:           changed_when: true
   166: 
   167:         - name: Verify /ip tftp rows landed (plumbing check)
   168:           ansible.builtin.include_tasks: transport/plumbing_check.yml
